# packages needed to run unit tests (including extra supported http libraries)
# version requirements: all supported versions (currently 3.9-3.14)

httpx2 >= 2.0.0
# fallback when httpx2 isn't installed
# TODO: (DEVSDK-3427) remove httpx in the next major version
httpx >= 0.27.0
aiohttp == 3.12.15
# httpx2 requires anyio >= 4.10 since 2.9.0
anyio[trio] == 4.10.0

pytest-mock >= 2.0.0
pytest-xdist >= 1.31.0
pytest >= 6.0.0,<9.0.0
